sections.name: core
sections.blurb: the bundle itself — installer, queue engine, and the skills the protocol names

skills.name: github
skills.description: Applies commit and PR conventions, then polls review bots and CI until the PR can merge. Use when the user commits, opens a PR or handles review feedback. Not for judging a diff.

skills.name: init
skills.description: Installs or refreshes claude-arsenal/ in a host repo, or adds a workspace. Use when the user wants the arsenal set up, updated or a workspace added. Not for queueing tasks.

skills.name: queue-add
skills.description: Adds a task to the claude-arsenal queue. Use when the user wants a new task queued. Not for editing existing tasks.

skills.name: queue-next
skills.description: Claims the next unblocked queue task and runs the worker loop, optionally scoped by tag, workspace or title. Use when the user wants to resume work. Not for adding tasks.

skills.name: queue-status
skills.description: Reports queue counts and flags missing gates, handles and broken deps. Use when the user asks how the queue stands. Not for changing task status.

skills.name: session-end
skills.description: Wraps up a session — optional handoff, skill-update proposals from repeated errors, a PR audit. Use when the user signals the job is done. Not for mid-job checkpoints.

sections.name: android
sections.blurb: diagnosing Android devices from the bugreports they produce

skills.name: bugreport
skills.description: Reads Android bugreports (dumpstate .txt or .zip) through a byte-offset index — device summary, ranked checkup, section lookup, merged timeline, redacted copies, report diffs. Use when the user has a bugreport to read or diagnose. Not for live-device adb sessions or logcat-only files.

sections.name: extract
sections.blurb: structured data out of artifacts you did not produce

skills.name: har
skills.description: Records, searches, filters and redacts HAR captures and turns them into scrapers. Use when the user has or needs a HAR capture. Not for non-capture JSON or HTML.

sections.name: python
sections.blurb: the Python toolchain — coverage, mutation, dependency and release skills

skills.name: coverage-gaps
skills.description: Ranks the most valuable missing tests from coverage.py's coverage.json. Use when the user asks which tests are missing. Not for non-Python code.

skills.name: dep-upgrade
skills.description: Upgrades a uv project's dependencies behind pip-audit and tests. Use when the user wants dependencies upgraded or vuln-checked. Not for adding one (uv add).

skills.name: mutmut-report
skills.description: Triages surviving mutmut mutants and reports the test fixes worth making. Use when the user asks which mutants survived. Not for running mutmut or coverage (coverage-gaps).

skills.name: pin-check
skills.description: Reverts a line, runs the scoped test and reports whether it pins the behaviour. Use when the user asks if a test catches a change. Not for mutation scoring.

skills.name: pypi-release
skills.description: Runs the PyPI release runbook — build, twine check, version bump, tag, upload. Use when the user wants a Python package published. Not for project scaffolding.

skills.name: python-bootstrap
skills.description: Scaffolds or retrofits a Python project with uv, ruff, strict mypy and a standard Makefile. Use when the user sets up Python tooling. Not for publishing.

sections.name: workflow
sections.blurb: the spec → design → execute → review → ship discipline

skills.name: design
skills.description: Turns an approved spec into contracts, risks and a gated task plan. Use when the user plans how to build scoped work. Not for investigation (specify).

skills.name: execution
skills.description: Implements a planned task test-first, through to a merge-ready PR. Use when the user is building what a plan describes. Not for one-off scripts.

skills.name: explore-idea
skills.description: Shapes a vague idea one question at a time with a decision log, then hands off to specify. Use when the user has an idea but no stated problem, or ideas to sort. Not for a stated problem.

skills.name: gate-check
skills.description: Reports PASS/FAIL with measured numbers on a plan task's acceptance gate, or audits all gates. Use when the user asks whether a gate passed. Not for writing code.

skills.name: review
skills.description: Reviews a PR, diff, design doc or proposal for risks and standards. Use when the user wants something reviewed. Not for release sign-off (ship).

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Confirms a change is production-ready — compatibility, tests, observability, rollback. Use when the user wants release sign-off. Not for PR review (review).

skills.name: specify
skills.description: Investigates a problem or an unclear-impact feature and proposes options. Use when the user has a problem to understand before building. Not for scoped work (design).
